fields.Name: Cheese Foundations Certificate
fields.Description: Entry-level credential covering milk handling, basic make procedures, hygiene and cheese styles. No prerequisite; the usual first step into the federation's credential ladder.

fields.Name: Food Safety & HACCP Certificate
fields.Description: Hazard analysis, environmental monitoring and recall readiness for small and mid-sized creameries. Shortest validity in the programme: food-safety practice moves, so holders recertify every two years.

fields.Name: Certified Cheesemonger
fields.Description: Counter-side credential: cut and wrap, storage and rotation, customer guidance, and building a balanced case. Popular with retail members.

fields.Name: Certified Cheese Professional (CCP)
fields.Description: The federation's flagship professional credential. Requires documented working hours and a foundation certificate, and covers make procedures, affinage, safety and business practice end to end.

fields.Name: Sensory Evaluation Certificate
fields.Description: Structured tasting, defect identification and scoring against style standards. The usual route onto a competition judging panel.

fields.Name: Advanced Affinage Certificate
fields.Description: Advanced maturation practice: rind management, cave environment control and maturation planning across styles. Open to CCP holders.

fields.Name: Competition Judge Accreditation
fields.Description: Accreditation to judge federation competitions. Requires the sensory certificate plus supervised panel experience, and lapses quickly without active judging.
